# onyx_agent_label (Resource)

A label that groups agents in the agent list. Reference its `id` from `onyx_agent.label_ids`. Deleting a label removes it from every agent. Any user can create a label, but rename and delete need full admin access, so manage labels with an admin API key. Import with the numeric label id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onyx_agent_label" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

resource "onyx_agent" "oncall" {
  name        = "On-call helper"
  description = "Answers questions about runbooks."
  label_ids   = [onyx_agent_label.engineering.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Label name. Names are unique. A change renames the label in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric label id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import by numeric label id.
terraform import onyx_agent_label.engineering 4
```
